glosses: sorry, excuse me, I beg your pardon

examples.text: Pardon! Zaraz to pozbieram.
Pardon me for stepping on your foot.

glosses: Polite expression used to soften a contradiction.

examples.text: Pardon me, but that is not true.

glosses: Polite expression to ask someone to repeat an utterance.

examples.text: Pardon me, I didn't hear you.

glosses: Used to express an apology for an action.

examples.text:
“Not like cats!” cried the Mouse, in a shrill, passionate voice. “Would you like cats if you were me?”
“Well, perhaps not,” said Alice in a soothing tone: “don’t be angry about it. And yet I wish I could show you our cat Dinah: I think you’d take a fancy to cats if you could only see her. She is such a dear quiet thing,” Alice went on, half to herself, as she swam lazily about in the pool, “and she sits purring so nicely by the fire, licking her paws and washing her face—and she is such a nice soft thing to nurse—and she’s such a capital one for catching mice⸺oh, I beg your pardon!” cried Alice again, for this time the Mouse was bristling all over, and she felt certain it must be really offended. “We won’t talk about her any more if you’d rather not.”

York got down and said very respectfully, "I beg your pardon, my lady, but these horses have not been reined up for three years, and my lord said it would be safer to bring them to it by degrees; but if your ladyship pleases, I can take them up a little more."

glosses: Used to request something, for example if a statement was not heard.

examples.text:
"We were talking of the man whom my mother one day caused to exist, and created gardener at Saint-Omer. She gave him a name. Henceforth he acted."
"I beg your pardon, sir?" said Monsieur Goubin, wiping his eye-glasses. "Do you mind saying that over again?"
"Willingly," replied Monsieur Bergeret. "There was no gardener. The gardener did not exist. My mother said: 'I expect the gardener!' Straightway the gardener existed—and acted."

glosses: Used to ask for clarification of something said if it is unexpected, odd or seen as rude without context.

Primera persona del singular (yo) del presente de subjuntivo de disculpar o de disculparse.
Tercera persona del singular (él, ella, ello; usted, 2.ª persona) del presente de subjuntivo de disculpar o de disculparse.
Segunda persona del singular (usted) del imperativo de disculpar o del imperativo negativo de disculparse.
Argumento con el que se intenta negar o quitar importancia a una culpa.
La razón y causa que se da para excusarse.
Pretexto, achaque para cubrir el expediente.
επιφώνημα που δηλώνει μετάνοια ή δικαιολόγηση ενόχλησης ή διακοπής

examples.text: Συγγνώμη! δε θα το ξανακάνω! Συγχώρεσέ με!
Συγγνώμη! μήπως ξέρετε πού είναι η οδός Ερμού;

※ Ο βασιλιάς όμως, βυθισμένος στις σκέψεις του, προσπαθώντας να βρει τρόπο να αντιμετωπίσει τους Βίκινγκς, ξεχάστηκε εντελώς. Φυσικά το καρβέλι έγινε κάρβουνο και, όταν επέστρεψε η γυναίκα, κουρασμένη και πεινασμένη, έβαλε τις φωνές στον Αλφρέδο, ο οποίος, μετανιωμένος και λυπημένος, της ζήτησε πολλές φορές συγγνώμη. (Σαραντίτη Ελένη, Οι άνθρωποι του Βορρά: Βίκινγκς - η ιστορία τους, εκδ. Πατάκη, 2026)

examples.text: Ζητώ συγγνώμη για το λάθος μου, δεν θα το επαναλάβω.
Μια συγγνώμη από μέρους του θα έλυνε την παρεξήγηση.

Θα ταξιδέψουμε με πλοίο.
Οι εργάτες σκάβουν με τις αξίνες.
Έχει εμμονή με την καθαριότητα.
Δεν άντεξα με όσα άκουγα κι έβαλα τις φωνές.
